releases.description:
- build: require engine 0.33.0
- refactor: add helper methods with ClassTarget.addMethod instead of hand-built placeholder bodies
- refactor: build against the restructured patch api

- build: require engine 0.32.0
- feat: add Reseam's socials, Donate and Request a patch to every app's settings about card
- perf(gmscore): rename only content URIs that start with the prefix
- fix(universal): give clones their own resource-backed provider authorities and account types, so they install and stay signed in beside the original
- perf(x): find the timeline query implementations from the class index
- fix(x): hide the Edit with Premium entry in post menus
- feat(x): unlock Premium through the stored subscriptions, so app colors and icons work too

- fix(youtube): match Shorts overlay filters on each component's own element without theme resources, which hid the title and channel on 20.26
- fix(youtube): label the like button in the action bar that shows likes under the title, so like and dislike counts line up
- feat(youtube): add 144p and 240p to the default video quality choices

- build: require engine 0.31.0
- feat(youtube): add Download to the menus of Shorts' cards in feeds, search and channels
- fix(youtube): save downloads that came as one progressive MP4 with video and audio together
- fix(youtube): hide the Shorts share and remix buttons by their accessibility ID instead of their position
- fix(youtube): complete the Android 8 and 9 port for Save to device, Download Shorts, Unlock queue, Theme and Dim Shorts overlay
- feat: support YouTube 20.26.46 and 21.23.492, the last releases for Android 8 and 9
- fix(youtube): present elements the server marks for RenderNext with litho so the filters keep seeing them
- fix(youtube): stop forcing the Shorts overlay onto the Litho renderer, which left it blank for accounts served RenderNext overlays
- feat(universal): disable playstore updates patch
- build: require engine 0.30.0

- build: require engine 0.29.0
- style: remove comments that restate the code in the download extensions
- perf: save downloads to device by writing their streams directly instead of remuxing them
- feat(youtube): add Download Shorts, a native Download item in the Shorts player menu
- feat(youtube): add Save to device for downloaded videos, with optional saving of every new download
- feat(youtube-music): add Save to device for downloaded songs and playlists, with optional saving of every new download
- feat(youtube-music): add Unlock downloads for songs, playlists and offline playback on free accounts

- feat(reddit): add Color comment thread lines and Hide community drawer items
- fix(x): add the Reseam Settings row to the legacy settings screen too
- fix: make reseam settings icon follow theme

- feat(youtube): save experiment flags to Downloads by long-pressing Reseam Settings in YouTube and YouTube Music
- fix(youtube): request the original audio language only from clients that return one track
- fix(youtube): keep the navigation bar visible when the feed also hides its container
- feat(instagram): add a Reseam Settings button to the profile, older posts after the following feed and Hide suggested Reels
- fix(tiktok): hide the ads inserted between a profile's videos
- fix(reddit): keep reporting post views so Home stops repeating posts, with a Block post views toggle
- fix(reddit): hide the comment ads the post detail ad loader places
- fix: look up app resources under the package they were built with, so renamed apps find them
- feat: add the native Android playback client, choosing each client's token automatically

- fix(youtube): bind server PoTokens to the caller's content binding
- chore: move donations page to /donate
- ci: use the node24 releases of the checkout, cache and setup actions

- build: require engine 0.28.0
- ci: build and release in the shared CI image through just

- fix: keep hook registrations to one run, so a patch the engine undoes does not register its hooks twice
- build: require engine 0.27.0

- build: require engine 0.26.3
- feat(youtube): show the Cast button by default and add Restore Cast Play/Queue dialog
- feat: use Reseam GmsCore by default, with Cast and only its media route providers

- fix(tiktok): show the Reseam settings gear on the signed-in profile
- feat(tiktok): add Fix login, which makes logging in with Google and Facebook work
- feat(tiktok): add TikTok patches
- fix(youtube): stop Scrubbing preview crashing the app when a video changes

- build: require engine 0.26.0
- feat(youtube): add Search inside channels and Live rings open the channel
- feat(youtube): add Play Shorts as regular videos and Turn off Shorts, which covers every Shorts hiding setting
- fix(youtube): open YouTube links in the patched app when another YouTube is installed
- fix: ship the GmsCore texts so its startup warnings show instead of crashing YouTube and YouTube Music

- build: require engine 0.25.0
- feat(youtube): add Material You to Theme and color the surfaces current YouTube uses
- feat(youtube): add Keep navigation bar visible, which stops the bottom bar hiding on scroll
- fix(youtube): hide the floating microphone on the search screens
- feat: support YouTube 21.40.166, X 12.34.0, Instagram 451.0.0.53.80 and Reddit 2026.41.0
- feat: list Reseam Settings first in every app's settings
- chore: add funding links

- build: require engine 0.24.0
- feat(discord): write extensions in TypeScript with before and after hooks and Discord module imports, and add Add source cards
- fix: adjust default patches and in-app settings for launch

- build: require engine 0.23.0
- refactor: port all extensions to Kotlin with @Export bindings, settings modules and string tables, and drop the ReVanced header from files that no longer hold its code
- feat(discord): add Custom themes, which creates, edits, previews and shares full themes, with a Reseam theme

- feat(telegram): choose which chats Recover deleted messages covers from the chat menu
- fix(telegram): show recovered messages only inside the range Telegram loaded, so a deleted latest message shows again

- fix(telegram): make Recover deleted messages opt-in
- fix(telegram): show recovered messages only inside the loaded page, so newer messages stop disappearing
- docs(discord): describe how extensions reach Discord's modules
- feat(discord): add Server details to a server's options: owner, creation date, members, boosts and more
- feat(discord): add Draft preview, which shows a message only you see when you long press send
- feat(discord): add Jump to first message, a button above Jump to present
- feat(discord): add Colored names, which colors members in mentions, typing, voice and member list headers
- feat(discord): add Moderator badges, which tag the owner, admins, managers and moderators in chat
- feat(discord): add Better stream quality, which streams at the qualities Nitro unlocks
- build: require engine 0.22.0

- fix(youtube): hide product stickers in Shorts
- feat(youtube): hide the toolbar messages button
- refactor(youtube): rename the Downloads patch to External downloader
- fix(youtube): answer refused downloads with spoofing off, so they work on mounted installs
- feat: brand every app's settings screen as Reseam on the engine's app runtime, with icons
- fix(youtube): make Unlock queue work on the first launch

- feat(youtube): add Unlock downloads, which downloads in every quality, also where YouTube offers no free downloads
- feat(youtube): try visionOS before TV Simply when spoofing streams
- feat(youtube): add Unlock queue, which makes Play next and Play last in queue work without Premium
- refactor(youtube): share the protobuf helpers through youtube-common
- fix(youtube): keep downloads out of stream spoofing, which left them stuck at 0%

- ci: keep the release history in patches.json and add the commits since the previous tag as release notes
- build: require engine 0.20.2

releases.description:
- chore: bump Reseam to 0.32.0
- test(e2e): keep "a GIF" two words in GIF names ("…-shows-a-gif-…")
- fix(e2e): exit 0 from record.sh --changed-since when no scenario changed
- test(e2e): keep a run of capitals with a digit inside, like E2E, one word in a scenario's GIF name
- test(e2e): stop patching every scenario with Patches entry in settings
- test(e2e): close the left menu BaconReader comes back from the login with, and fill the login fields without the keyboard
- test(e2e): refuse a logged-out app as Reddit does (403 Blocked), log in before loading posts, and document the emulator's hidden proxy
- test(e2e): play every scenario against the fake Reddit, and test All logged out, logging in with Spoof client and a GIF in a comment
- test(e2e): name the views Embed comment images shows a comment's GIFs and images in, so the e2e tests find them

patches.name: Disable feedback popup
patches.description: Disables the "Please take a few moments to provide feedback about BaconReader" popup.

patches.name: Disable final release announcement
patches.description: Disables the "FINAL RELEASE ANNOUNCEMENT!" popup that says goodbye when the app starts.

patches.name: Disable unavailable sidebar
patches.description: Disables "View Sidebar" on Front Page, All, Popular, Friends and multireddits, which have no sidebar.

patches.name: Embed comment images
patches.description: Shows images, GIFs, emotes, Imgur albums and videos in comments and posts, YouTube links with their title and thumbnail, and X and Bluesky links as the post.

patches.name: Fix empty saved files
patches.description: Fixes saving media to the device also creating an empty file.

patches.name: Fix Imgur API
patches.description: Makes Imgur albums and galleries load again, and image uploads in comments and posts work.

patches.name: Fix list thumbnails
patches.description: Fixes empty thumbnails in the post list, shows a preview as thumbnail for link posts and crossposted galleries, and blurs the thumbnails of NSFW and spoiler posts.

patches.name: Fix lost post votes
patches.description: Keeps votes on a post in the post list when they're made while its comments load.

patches.name: Fix meme templates
patches.description: Makes the meme templates of the drawing screen load again, with Imgflip's most used templates.

patches.name: Fix Redgifs API
patches.description: Makes Redgifs videos play again.

patches.name: Fix unread messages
patches.description: Turns the orange inbox envelope back to normal when the last unread message is marked as read, and removes "Mark unread", which Reddit no longer supports.

patches.name: Flair filter
patches.description: Adds a Flair button to the sort bar of subreddits, to show only the posts with the chosen flairs.

patches.name: Hide formatted spoilers
patches.description: Hides spoilers that contain formatting, links or code, like other spoilers.

patches.name: Improve post media loading
patches.description: Shows a still preview with a progress bar and the downloaded size while post media and gallery images load, uses small previews for the thumbnails of galleries, shows a message instead of a broken page when a RedGIFs video was deleted, and adds settings for which link post pages run JavaScript.

patches.name: Inbox comment reply screen
patches.description: Opens the comment reply screen, with the replied comment or message, when replying from the inbox, instead of the plain "Send message" form.

patches.name: Load more comments
patches.description: Adds options to load up to 500 comments when opening a post instead of about 200, and to load the "load more comments" with few replies automatically.

patches.name: Markdown editor
patches.description: Makes the text box of comments, replies, edits, messages and text posts as big as possible, with a bar of Reddit's formats and a character counter, and shows the formatting while typing.

patches.name: Patches entry in settings
patches.description: Adds a Patches entry at the end of BaconReader's settings, which opens the patches' settings, and shows the patches' version at the bottom of the menu.

patches.name: Prompt to open Reddit links
patches.description: Asks once to set up Reddit links to open in BaconReader, which Android doesn't let the app do by itself.

patches.name: Reddit chat
patches.description: Adds Chat to the menu, next to the Inbox, which shows Reddit's chat from its mobile website on the main screen. The chat messages Reddit also sends to the inbox are counted next to Chat and notified as chat messages instead.

patches.name: Remove awards
patches.description: Removes the award icons and the "Give Award" and "View Award Details" actions, which no longer work.

patches.name: Remove Random feeds
patches.description: Removes Random and My Random, which no longer load, from the feed list.

patches.name: Save videos with sound
patches.description: Adds the sound to Reddit videos saved with "Save to device", which were saved without it.

patches.name: Search comments
patches.description: Adds a search button to the sort bar of posts, to find, highlight and jump between the comments with a text or user name, or show only those comments.

patches.name: Show request errors
patches.description: Shows the actual error when a Reddit request fails, instead of the message saying that BaconReader stopped working in July 2023.

patches.name: Show tables
patches.description: Shows tables in comments and posts as a grid, with wide tables that expand and scroll sideways.

patches.name: Show user avatars
patches.description: Adds an option to show the author's avatar before the name in comments, as on Reddit's website.

patches.name: Spoof client
patches.description: Makes logging in to Reddit work again by using another Reddit app's client ID.

options.title: Application client ID
options.description: The client ID of an "Installed app" from https://www.reddit.com/prefs/apps.

options.title: Application redirect URI
options.description: The redirect URI of that Reddit app. Empty keeps BaconReader's own, http://baconreader.com/auth.

options.title: Application user agent
options.description: The user agent of that Reddit app, ideally. Empty keeps BaconReader's own.

patches.name: Text post icon
patches.description: Shows the button that opens a text post's text in the post list as a page with a chevron, instead of a play button.

patches.name: Video autoplay in detail view
patches.description: Adds a setting to stop videos, such as v.redd.it videos, from loading and playing by themselves in a post's detail view: the post shows its preview image, and a tap on it plays the video.
